name: Treasure chest
style: low-poly, flat colours, banded wooden chest with gold trim and lock (Quaternius 2021)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (Quaternius's animated treasure chest on poly.pizza, clips Chest_Open and Chest_Close) is behind a Cloudflare challenge. This is the same Quaternius chest as shipped in the Ultimate Platformer Pack on itch.io (free download; License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0): Level and Mechanics/Chest.fbx, the pack's only chest, rigged (Root, Chest_Bottom, Chest_Top) with the plan's two clips, a domed banded lid, a hasp, studs and a heap of star coins inside. The FBX carries each clip twice (Chest_Open and Chest_Open_, Chest_Close and Chest_Close_); keepActions keeps one of each. Both clips are cartoon: the box rocks back with a squash before the lid flips about 180 degrees onto its back (open, 0.79 s), and the reverse with a settle (close, 0.92 s); they play once (loop false) and ground clamp keeps the rocking corner from sinking. Hold the end frames with the poses 'opened' and 'shut'. Size: 0.71 m wide, 0.62 m deep, 0.60 m tall closed (height set so the width lands in the 0.6-0.8 m of a real chest). Lock faces +Z (front). Colours on noon: accent red-brown wood shading to iris brown, iron bands and rims hair-dark shading to iris, hasp, studs and coins in the pale sky cream as gold (noon has no yellow; on festival or indigo map gold to practical), the coin stars iris.
